title: Rules as Data Table
description: The rule set is a lookup table, not a match statement.
body: CATALOG holds one row per rule: its identifier, the name the `RULE` column draws, its severity, and the function that finds it. A fourteenth rule is one row and one function rather than a new arm inside an existing one. That is the shape EdgeKind uses, and it is deliberate: a linter is where a list of special cases accumulates.
